# C2 source-first completeness preflight

Verdict: **REPAIR REQUIRED — the map preserves every distinct C2 product
outcome, but it is not yet source-complete because two traceability obligations
are only implicit.** These are record repairs, not evidence of a C2 product
defect and not authority to expand C2 implementation.

## Scope and independence

I authored C1, not C2. I read the retained C2 source and live issue #477 before
reading the proposed map. This is a bounded high-tier completeness preflight,
not a fresh-context outside-score assessment, campaign score, architecture
review, delivery review, or claim that any C2 implementation succeeds.

No code, repository source, GitHub state, review marker, benchmark, Cargo
process, score, or mission projection was changed or run for this preflight.
The only write is this requested scratch report.

## Exact inspected inputs

- Retained source:
  `C:/src/quantick-worktrees/outside-eight-coordination/c2-source-for-preflight.md`
  — 4,317 bytes; SHA-256
  `D13F57B1E16E4D654CD37E0C7E503398417C282FC534886F60789B8916167702`.
- Live issue: https://github.com/milocaetano/quantick/issues/477, read directly;
  its title is `ci(app): measure incremental edit loops and run full checks on
  Windows` and its live body matches the retained issue clauses inspected here.
- Proposed map, read only after deriving the source obligations:
  `C:/src/quantick-worktrees/outside-eight-coordination/c2-preflight-plan.md`
  — 23,365 bytes; actual map SHA-256
  `362FFF02EB447E167C57B8BA65C18330F9B618F32587791D06F20101E8AF199A`.
- Canonical mission and delivery contracts, plus the campaign integration
  contract, were read to classify product asks separately from gates and
  closing steps.

## Source-first obligation set

Before reading the map, I derived these distinct C2 outcomes and constraints:

1. Every pull request must run format, workspace clippy, workspace build, and
   the entire workspace test suite on Windows alongside Linux while preserving
   the pinned toolchain and dependency policy.
2. Incremental `cargo test -p crate` cost must be measured after touching one
   production file in each actual top-three crate under the frozen definition,
   on an identified host, with committed raw results tied to an exact SHA and a
   measurement date under 30 days old.
3. A scheduled job must enforce justified edit-loop budgets and retain failure
   evidence. It must not substitute easier crates or present undeclared warm
   timings as another kind of measurement.
4. Applicable CI failures exposed by the work must be diagnosed and fixed
   honestly: no weakened assertion, removed check, hidden historical flake, or
   settings workaround. Settings changes are one-line parent tasks for the
   trader and do not block implementation.
5. C2 must preserve the frozen measurement/independent-assessment boundary,
   the three named campaign defect fixes, every repository invariant, and
   ticket/replay behavior. It supplies facts rather than scoring itself.

The remaining source clauses are operational obligations, not extra product
requirements: high tier and strongest routing; C1 integrated-green dependency;
one isolated child worktree on the latest campaign base; safe source restoration;
the full local loop, timing fixtures and actual two-OS CI; exact-head reviews
and reachable campaign integration; durable issue/PR/parent evidence identities;
initial operation/repair counters of zero with failures retained across
sessions; and no main/shared-worktree/settings mutation by the child.

## Reconciliation against the proposed IDs

| Existing map | Result | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1 / A1 | Complete | It retains both operating systems, the exact four commands, pin/policy preservation and actual exact-head job evidence. |
| R2 / A2 | Complete | It retains frozen top-three selection, production-file touch, identified inputs/host, raw warm-up/control/touched evidence, exact clean code SHA, age, restoration and recompilation proof. |
| R3 / A3 | Complete | It retains fixed calibrated budgets, top-three and host validation, failure artifacts, negative fixtures and refusal of all-fresh, invalid or over-budget evidence. |
| R4 / A4 | Complete | It preserves original failures, forbids the named weakening mechanisms, requires scoped repair/diagnosis and keeps settings as non-blocking parent work. |
| R5 / A5 | Traceability gap C2-PF1 | The row covers freeze, independence, general invariants, ticket and replay, but does not name preservation of the three explicit feed/control defect outcomes incorporated by issue #477. |
| G1–G5 / C1–C3 | Traceability gap C2-PF2 | The principal high-tier, worktree, validation, review, authority and integration gates exist, but issue #477's durable identity/evidence destinations and initial retry-counter state are not recorded. |

No distinct source outcome is missing from R1–R4/A1–A4. No new product R/A
pair is warranted for repeated full-loop, worktree, review, evidence-routing or
authority clauses; those correctly belong in G/C.

## Required repairs

### C2-PF1 — explicitly preserve the three named campaign defect outcomes

Type: **traceability gap**, not a demonstrated implementation defect.

Source span: issue scope says the child remains under the parent source,
“including the three explicit defect fixes,” and the retained parent request
names:

- automatic Binance reconnect and MT5 in-connection sequence gaps must not
  lose trades without `FeedGap` or a health counter;
- a possibly executed mutating capability must not answer an unkeyed
  timeout/lost transport as retryable;
- `quantick_invoke` must retain idempotency-key carriage.

R5/A5 currently says only “all existing guards/ticket/replay coverage retained.”
That broad phrase does not preserve the identity of these three campaign-level
constraints, especially because A4 permits scoped product fixes if Windows CI
exposes them.

Repair R5/A5 in place; do not add a sixth product outcome. Name preservation of
the integrated feed-gap/health telemetry and mutation uncertainty/idempotency
semantics alongside ticket/replay. Evidence may reuse exact-head full tests and
the existing named regressions when those inputs are unchanged; if a C2 repair
touches an affected area, run the applicable targeted regression. C2 is not
asked to reimplement already integrated sibling outcomes.

### C2-PF2 — carry the issue's progress and evidence-routing state into G/C

Type: **operational traceability gap**, not an R/A gap.

Source span: issue #477 specifies evidence in its comments, linked current-head
PR checks/review reports and parent checkpoints; it leaves concrete issue,
Project, branch, worktree, PR/head/base and checkpoint identities null until
readback; and initializes `operation=0`, `repair=0` while requiring failures to
survive sessions.

G4/G5 say reviews and root publication authority exist, but do not preserve
those initial counters, identity readbacks or destinations. Extend an existing
gate or add one operational gate that records the zero baselines, retains all
failed attempts/evidence under the delivery progress contract, fills the
concrete identities after readback, and routes evidence to the named child PR,
issue and parent checkpoints. Do not create duplicate product criteria.

## Confirmed non-findings and implementation cautions

- Five touched samples and the provisional `1.25 * max + 5 seconds` rule are
  implementation defaults, not source outcomes. The parent's autonomous
  delegation permits choosing them, but the persisted high-tier mission should
  record them as explicit assumptions/decisions and keep the budgets unknown
  until real hosted-runner calibration.
- Exercising the identical scheduled-budget job through a PR trigger while the
  actual cron remains pending until the workflow reaches the default branch is
  an honest platform constraint, not a narrowing of A3.
- The plan correctly separates warm-up, no-touch control and touched samples;
  “no silently warmed timings” does not require pretending a warm incremental
  experiment is cold-build evidence.
- The dense-runtime benchmark list is explicitly non-acceptance material and
  does not expand C2.
- The inspected C1 planning head is historical input, not the C2 implementation
  base. G2 correctly requires the coordinator to bind the child to the latest
  fetched, verified C1-integrated campaign tip before any edit.
- The proposed concrete top-three files and counts remain provisional until
  recomputed with the frozen tool at measurement SHA H. Rejecting drift rather
  than substituting a crate is faithful to the source.

After C2-PF1 and C2-PF2 are repaired without renumbering R1–R5/A1–A5, the map
is source-complete for implementation preflight. The strongest coordinator
review should inspect that revised map and record its exact new SHA-256 before
authorizing implementation; this report does not perform or pre-award that
conformance readback.
